scope.separate_from: Owner0.32 subtotal assessment; current original restored ordinary item5column report,2axis/toggle read-only observations pending parent

answer.known: Generic free-aggregate conditions feed per-axis summary model/row definitions, show_subtotal→subtot_tf flags, typed boundary keys, accumulator metadata and title resolvers. Inventory and output consumers are retained.
answer.unknown: Exact current purchase control value/default binding, final hierarchical row emission/order/rollup algorithm and server formulas are not established. External FlexionErp.WidgetDLTBuilder/data_generator consumes the config. No complete original subtotal parity claim.

defaults_and_toggle.selector_default: New selected free-axis generic popup return object sets show_subtotal:true and sort_type:A. Receiving component may override; no captured btn-add-sum/unadd-sum handler or current serialized toggle value.
defaults_and_toggle.fixed_default: Fixed details_target.props→condition conversion sets show_subtotal:false. This is a different route, not evidence that newly selected free axes default OFF.
defaults_and_toggle.free_normalization: Free aggregate drops details_target and otherwise preserves aggregate object/condition fields. No local show_subtotal coercion/default is added here.
defaults_and_toggle.UI_unknown: Do not map plus/minus class to actual Boolean or infer default ON/OFF solely from selector/fixed transformation. Parent current read-only result observation is separate, not performed by worker.

request_and_backend.conditions: When registered mapper emits matching aggregate condition, normalizeAggregateRequest replaces its value with normalized aggregate. Free condition_NN including show_subtotal can remain in that value; actual equal_condition/aggregate callback registrations/current DMC metadata are external.
request_and_backend.groups: rebuildAggregateGroups extracts valid selected prop IDs, deduplicates and replaces groups. groups entries themselves do not encode show_subtotal. Fixed Line clears groups.
request_and_backend.server: SelectInventoryStatusProgram delegates conditions/sorts/groups/page/limit/template context to SelectInventorySearchStatusAction and returns result.data/total_number/date. No backend code or response was fetched/executed. Whether flag alters server response versus client display remains unknown.

axis_hierarchy_and_models.axis_order: Select truthy condition_NN entries with prop_id and sort by numeric suffix; gaps are allowed and selected axes compact to consecutive levels1..N.
axis_hierarchy_and_models.models: Free path creates summary1..N DMC models with model_refer_type subtotal1..N, using dynamic summary item definitions. Model creation loops selected axes without filtering show_subtotal; data models initially empty.
axis_hierarchy_and_models.row_definitions: getNewRowInfos$1 emits new-row info per selected axis level and each template body row, if corresponding summaryN DMC exists; carries acc_standard=aggregate and row_definition_index. Even missing standard column may still permit summary-row definitions.
axis_hierarchy_and_models.limit: These are level/model/template definitions. They do not establish number/position of emitted rows, whether leaf subtotal duplicates body row, parent-prefix tree policy, collapse behavior or grand total placement.

show_flag_and_config.pipeline: buildSummarySort maps selected condition to sort_seq1..N, sort_prop=prop_id, subtot_tf=show_subtotal; asc_desc=A, page_separate_tf=false, subtot_standard=N, subtot_nm_tf=false,count_mark_tf=false. createSummaryConfig builds group config/value extractor/title resolver; free grid aggregate stores as feature_configs.data_generator.summary_config.
show_flag_and_config.guards: getGroupAggregateConfigs skips missing summaryN DMC/prop/type, numeric grouping prop, Count grouping in free aggregate and unsupported date unit Skip. Eligible entries carry subtot_tf unchanged, accumulator metadata,row_title_prop_id,count flags.
show_flag_and_config.OFF: False flag still exists in config and model/row definitions can still be created. Final visibility/accumulation suppression is delegated; do not equate OFF with removal of grouping, server rows or aggregate model.
show_flag_and_config.distinction: Free summary_config differs from sort-popup subtotal_config and fixed pagetotal/total. Do not import sort-dialog row placement or global total rules into per-axis free subtotal.

keys_calculation_order.keys: Boundary extractor uses $$code.value.code; date/date_no/date_record_seq_no values select data_dt when object, then typed date-unit truncation (Year first4,Month first6,other unchanged); unsupported Skip→null; missing→empty string; other types value??empty. This is a client boundary key extractor, not proof of backend/SID group identity.
keys_calculation_order.accumulators: For numeric section props collect standard_by_type and association_prop_id. Empty standard excludes; nonaggregate runtime clears explicit standard before fallback. total_calc_num association uses associated standard or First, otherwise fallback Sum. Actual numeric accumulation/division/tax/rounding remains external engine/dynamic definition.
keys_calculation_order.sort: Synthetic A in summary-sort config is not general request ORDER BY proof. Request option_sort/dynamic mappers are separate. sort_seq is level metadata; final hierarchy and row ordering are external.
keys_calculation_order.override: If ui_sort config hook applies, it creates subtotal_config and deletes existing summary_config. Search-sort hook also sets subtotal_config. Current hook ordering/active attributes and precedence in current purchase runtime unobserved.
keys_calculation_order.no_formula_claim: Do not infer summing the four visible columns is always original correct: dynamic per-property standard/association/value-format and server values may alter behavior.

subtotal_label_and_row_output.title: Resolve current group name by data type/value-format; if empty use[]. Append space + custom_display_name suffix if truthy else resource rex00205. Source does not contain resolved current Korean suffix value.
subtotal_label_and_row_output.parents: Only subtot_nm_tf=true joins prior sort-level names with space/slash/space before suffix. Synthetic free summary sort sets thisfalse, so its requested default title is current axis name only, not an inferred full-parent path.
subtotal_label_and_row_output.types: Date title uses typed truncate+value formatter; enum/tf resolves refer_type then refer_group then datatype resource labels; code_cd may append(name) from paired nm_prop_id; default uses external value formatter.
subtotal_label_and_row_output.row_metadata: buildInfoForNewRow maps association body prop→section prop, title_prop, default styles/fonts,height,sort_seq,row_definition_index. Missing current dynamic summary definitions prevent exact cells,widths,merge/indent/label placement claims.

renderer_boundary.facts: Build WidgetDLTFeatConfigBuilder feature configs; pass widget/data_model/platform/features to new FlexionErp.WidgetDLTBuilder().execute. For nonexcel, syncDmcFromDltRawBody may update DMC from result.dlts. data_generator implementation and final row generation are external to identified81 sources.
renderer_boundary.limits: Previous renderer bodies with timeout/OOM remain failed/partial. Absence of subtotal tokens in them does not prove behavior absent. No new retry or execution was used.

CSV_Excel_print_boundaries.Excel_search: Excel resolver uses limit100000,page index1/row count100000 when present,is_excel_convert=true and default sort helper. Download resolver delegates data/definition/xtemplate/runtime/disposableDMC and payload.file_type(defaultxlsx) to excel$DownloadExcelProgram with security check. This is not proof of exporting only current visible rows.
CSV_Excel_print_boundaries.DLT_Excel: Same feature-config builder can feed platformexcel; may use origin DMC rows for repeated props, strips empty-line display blanks and does not sync generated data back to displayed DMC. Thus subtotal config can reach output engine, but exact serialized subtotal rows still depend on external engine/exporter/current definitions.
CSV_Excel_print_boundaries.CSV: Generic payload.file_type can pass through; direct current free-subtotal CSV serializer/schema/row-type policy not retained. No CSV export executed. Own CSV inclusion/exclusion/labels must be declared own policy.
CSV_Excel_print_boundaries.print: Common PrintSlipUserAction handles normal Status/SumStatus through AddGridAllRow action then PrintSlipSvc; graph has separate PrintGraph path. Preview dispatches AddGridAllRow then external print preview program. No direct show_subtotal-specific print formula/row-placement consumer was established.
CSV_Excel_print_boundaries.scope: No download, print, settings Save/Apply or private API executed. Formatting/security/logging/page breaks/full-row behavior cannot be claimed equivalent from dispatch alone.
